issue_type.instructions: Classify this issue or ticket into exactly one primary type. This is categorization only — not a severity ranking.

criteria.bug: Reports broken behavior, error, regression, or failure
criteria.feature: Requests new capability, enhancement, or improvement
criteria.question: Asks how something works; no bug or feature request
criteria.security: Reports vulnerability, exploit, leak, or security incident

urgency.instructions: Rate how urgently this issue needs human attention (1 = can wait, 10 = drop everything). Score independently of issue type.

criteria.1: Trivial or cosmetic; no user impact
criteria.10: Critical outage, active exploit, or severe user harm
